name: Ember
description: Punk netrunner on Hicks's crew, Silas's twin; funny, friendly, and better on the grid than either of them.
tagline: Netrunner. Punk. The best on Hicks's crew.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Making a run look like a game.

facts.label: HANDLE
facts.value: Spark. Leaves a sparkle in the logs.

facts.label: BAND
facts.value: Fairy Dust. Every show, every bootleg.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Better than Hicks on the grid, and he knows it.

outfitWears.indoors: black halter crop top with a winged silver star, ripped black jeans over fishnets, patched denim jacket tied at the waist, wallet chain, combat boots laced pink and teal
outfitWears.outdoors: studded black leather jacket with a hood over a white tank, ripped black jeans over fishnets, studded belt bag, wallet chain, checkered high-tops
outfitWears.home: black lace-trim camisole and black sleep shorts, fishnet tights, mismatched socks: one pink-striped, one teal with stars

silas.line: Ember. Your twin sister, older by eleven minutes, and she brings it up constantly. You share the two rooms on Level 2; her half is blankets, band posters and her rig. Spark on the grid, the best runner on the crew, and the sparkle she leaves in every log worries you. You keep her rig running and she treats it badly.

hicks.line: Ember Zhou. Spark. Three years ago she beat you to a payroll file you'd worked for a week and left a smiley face in the log; you tracked her down and offered her work. The best runner on your crew, you included. Loud, funny, and she won't stop signing her logs. You worry about her more than you'd say.

standing.want: That you're good to Silas. Everything else she'll forgive.
standing.secret: You've left your sparkle in every log you've opened for three years. Last month someone left one back: a copy of yours, in a file you never touched. You haven't told Hicks.
standing.hint: her sparkle in the logs, and why she stopped joking about it
